```{r, packages_data_fns}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

source("0_set_up.R")
source("R/page_helpers.R")

version <- "2025"

if (Sys.getenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true") {
  update_aa_victim_scroll()
  update_aa_victims(version)
}

aa_data <- import(glue("data/aa_data_wide_nogeo_{version}.rds", trust=TRUE))
victims <- readRDS(glue("data/victims_{version}.rds"))

kill_tot  <- sum(aa_data$kill_tot, na.rm = TRUE)
names_n   <- sum(!is.na(victims$victim) & trimws(victims$victim) != "")
yr_last   <- max(aa_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)
```

::: {.rem-intro}
# Remembrance

`{r} format_num(names_n)` names of the `{r} format_num(kill_tot)` people killed in active attacks in the United States, 2000 to `{r} yr_last`.

Let us pause to remember them, and to honor with courage and compassion their families and those who risked their lives to save others. We try to record every name we can find. If a name is missing or wrong, please [tell us](3_contact.qmd).

[Officer]{.rem-tag} law enforcement officer  [Under 18]{.rem-tag .rem-minor} under 18 years old
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
remembrance_names(victims)
```

::: {.rem-dnt}
### Don't Name Them

At ALERRT, it is our policy not to name the people responsible for active attacks. Research shows that many attacks are driven by a search for fame; by refusing to name attackers, we aim to remove fame and notoriety as a motive for future attacks. Learn more at [DontNameThem.org](https://www.dontnamethem.org).
:::

<script>
(function () {
  var box = document.getElementById("rem-search");
  if (!box) return;
  var out = document.querySelector(".rem-match");
  box.addEventListener("input", function () {
    var q = box.value.trim().toLowerCase(), hits = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll(".rem-year").forEach(function (sec) {
      var secHits = 0;
      sec.querySelectorAll(".rem-date").forEach(function (blk) {
        var n = 0;
        blk.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(function (li) {
          var show = !q || li.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
          li.hidden = !show; if (show) n++;
        });
        blk.hidden = n === 0; secHits += n;
      });
      sec.hidden = secHits === 0; hits += secHits;
    });
    out.textContent = q ? (hits === 1 ? "1 name matches" : hits + " names match") : "";
  });
})();
</script>
